description: Wave 3 of the 2026-09-23 expert panel (4.1.0, optimisation): a per-phase context budget with a hard-contracts core and closed load lists (R-15, reorganising every skill on top of the Wave 2 content), a per-change HTML page for the sponsor and 'your turn' events (R-19, D-31), open questions Q-NN and a risk register with owner and date (R-24), cost per change with a single agent (R-25, D-30), a project design system with design-graphic as a delta (R-26), an unambiguous WBS (R-27), an organisation-wide read-only portfolio (R-28, D-32), a WSJF-scored backlog with done-direct (R-29), a portability guide for Claude Code only (R-30, D-32) — plus the emergent backlog items that fit, and last the method page in four more languages (B-06).
goal: Every phase loads only the instructions it declares, and the sponsor of any change can read — from one page produced from the change's own artifacts — its scope, state, measured cost, open risks and the decisions it waits for, while the organisation sees every Karvey repo in one read-only portfolio; the per-phase instruction size and the cost per change are measured before and after, never capped.
security_tier_reason: the sponsor page and the portfolio read several repositories and publish a summary outside the team (information must not leak across clients or include secrets, internal paths or personal data); new scripts read project.json values (stakeholder, portfolio paths) into file reads and commands; the context reorganisation can drop a hard rule from a phase (a guard contract must survive the move)
